connector.name: Ecardwidget MCP
connector.registryDescription: Send eCards, run bulk campaigns, and automate recurring cards from your AI assistant.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ecardwidget-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ecardwidget account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ECW_API_KEY
env.description: Scoped eCardWidget API key (Settings → Developers → API Keys). Used as a Bearer token.

env.name: ECW_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default https://app.ecardwidget.com). For custom domains / testing.
